description: This file provides a MacBook multitouch support implementation for Kivy, including a custom MotionEvent class and a provider class that interfaces with macOS's MultitouchSupport framework to handle touch events.

classes.name: MacMotionEvent
classes.description: A custom MotionEvent representing a multitouch contact point on MacBook touchpad, supporting position and shape profiles.

classes.name: MacMotionEventProvider
classes.description: A provider class that interfaces with macOS's MultitouchSupport framework to generate touch events for Kivy.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MacMotionEvent class or provider, setting default parameters and ensuring singleton pattern for the provider.

methods.name: depack
methods.description: Extracts position and size data from input arguments to set the touch shape and coordinates.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MacMotionEvent.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts device detection and attaches callbacks for multitouch events.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Dispatches queued touch events to the main thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping the provider (not implemented).

methods.name: _mts_callback
methods.description: Callback function invoked by the MultitouchSupport framework to process touch data and generate events.
